people.dismissedHint: Dismissed people are disabled: they count nowhere — not in attendance, exports or dashboards. Their faces still show on the photos they were found in (Manage tab), for the record. Restore someone to count them again. Deleting, by contrast, erases a person's data for good.
people.dismissHint: Stop counting this person anywhere. Their data is kept and this can be undone.

people.confirmDelete:
Delete {{name}} for good?

Everything that identifies them is erased: selfie, face recognition data, the faces cut from group photos and every presence. This cannot be undone.

To just stop counting them, use Dismiss instead.
people.deleted: {{name}} and all of their data were deleted.

manage.title: Manage Data
manage.backupIntro: Compresses the whole {{folder}} folder — the SQLite file plus every uploaded photo, selfie and face crop — into a single archive you can download and keep.
manage.backupHintTarGz: tar stores names as raw bytes, so accents, Â, emoji and even names that aren't valid UTF-8 survive the round trip untouched.
manage.backupHintZip: Zip writes names as UTF-8. Anything the filesystem accepts but UTF-8 cannot represent is listed in backup-manifest.json inside the archive instead of being corrupted — pick .tar.gz if that matters.
manage.sessionsIntro: One entry per uploaded group photo. Fix a wrong date by moving the photo, or delete it to undo the whole upload.
manage.noFaces: No faces recorded for this photo.
manage.confirmDeletePhoto:
Delete "{{name}}" ({{date}})?

Every presence this photo produced will be removed. This cannot be undone.
